shots.shot_purpose: Attention-grabbing open — pose the quality question
shots.shot_description: Open with an animated question: 'How do we know AI-generated frames are any good?' with clean motion graphics.
shots.camera_framing_intent: Wide establishing frame with central text/icon animation
shots.visual_intent: Hook the viewer with a relatable quality concern
shots.asset_requirements_summary: motion_graphics_assets: title card template, pipeline icons
shots.qa_criteria_summary: text readable, animation smooth, branding consistent

shots.shot_description: Show a simplified AI production pipeline diagram flowing from model generation through QA checks to assembly.
shots.camera_framing_intent: Medium establishing shot of pipeline diagram
shots.visual_intent: Give viewer a mental map of the pipeline landscape
shots.qa_criteria_summary: diagram accurate, stages clearly labeled, flow direction clear

shots.shot_description: Display a grid of sample AI-generated frames showing varied quality — some sharp, some with artifacts, some well-composed.
shots.camera_framing_intent: Split-screen grid view with 4 sample frames
shots.subject_object_requirements: Sample generated frame images on grid
shots.visual_intent: Demonstrate the variability of raw AI generation output
shots.qa_criteria_summary: grid layout balanced, quality differences visible, annotations clear

shots.shot_description: Zoom into specific defects: bad cropping, distorted anatomy, color bleeding, missing elements with callout labels.
shots.camera_framing_intent: Close-up inspection view with magnifying glass effect
shots.subject_object_requirements: Defect callout overlays on sample frames
shots.visual_intent: Educate viewer on what defects look like and why they matter
shots.asset_requirements_summary: sample_frame_assets: defect example images, callout overlays
shots.qa_criteria_summary: defects clearly visible and labeled, examples representative

shots.shot_description: Animated flowchart showing frames entering the QA pipeline and moving through sequential check stations.
shots.camera_framing_intent: Wide establishing shot of QA pipeline flowchart
shots.subject_object_requirements: QA pipeline stations with entry/exit flow
shots.visual_intent: Show the structured nature of automated QA
shots.qa_criteria_summary: checkpoints clearly defined, flow direction intuitive

shots.shot_description: Detail the technical checks: format validation, resolution check, file integrity, color space verification with pass/fail badges.
shots.camera_framing_intent: Medium shot with check panel UI overlay
shots.subject_object_requirements: Technical checklist UI with status indicators
shots.visual_style_constraints: Technical UI style, clear_practical pass/fail badges
shots.qa_criteria_summary: technical terms clear, check results unambiguous

shots.shot_description: Show the visual QA system analyzing aesthetic criteria: composition, lighting, subject integrity, style consistency with score readouts.
shots.camera_framing_intent: Medium shot with QA scoring UI overlay on frame
shots.subject_object_requirements: QA score panel with visual analysis highlights
shots.visual_style_constraints: Analytics dashboard style, clear_practical scoring UI
shots.visual_intent: Demonstrate that QA goes beyond technical checks into aesthetic judgment
shots.asset_requirements_summary: motion_graphics_assets: QA scoring template, sample analyzed frames
shots.qa_criteria_summary: scores explained visually, analysis highlights meaningful

shots.shot_description: Present organized defect categories with visual examples grouped by type: technical, compositional, subject integrity, stylistic.
shots.camera_framing_intent: Grid/category layout with expandable defect cards
shots.subject_object_requirements: Defect category cards with example thumbnails
shots.visual_style_constraints: Organized taxonomy layout, clear_practical category coloring
shots.visual_intent: Systematize defect knowledge for the viewer
shots.asset_requirements_summary: motion_graphics_assets: defect taxonomy template with categories

shots.shot_description: Animated diagram showing the retry/correction loop: defect detected -> plan correction -> patch generation -> re-check -> pass or recycle.
shots.camera_framing_intent: Wide shot with correction loop cycle animation
shots.subject_object_requirements: Loop diagram with cycle arrows and decision diamonds
shots.visual_intent: Explain the self-healing aspect of the pipeline
shots.qa_criteria_summary: loop logic clear, decision points well explained

shots.shot_description: Show a previously-failing frame passing through re-check and getting approved, with visual diff before/after.
shots.camera_framing_intent: Before/after split comparison with approval badge
shots.visual_intent: Show that corrections work and quality improves
shots.asset_requirements_summary: sample_frame_assets: before/after frame pair, approval badge overlay
shots.qa_criteria_summary: improvement visible, approval clear and satisfying

shots.shot_description: Timeline view showing approved frames being added to the final sequence, with quality stamps and assembly progress.
shots.subject_object_requirements: Editing timeline with approved frame stamps
shots.visual_style_constraints: Timeline/editor UI style, clear_practical approved badges
shots.visual_intent: Show the payoff of all the QA work
shots.asset_requirements_summary: motion_graphics_assets: timeline template with frame thumbnails

shots.shot_description: Recap the key pipeline stages with a compact visual summary, reinforce the value of automated QA, end with a call to action.
shots.camera_framing_intent: Summary card layout with end screen
shots.subject_object_requirements: Pipeline recap graphic, end card with CTA
shots.visual_style_constraints: Clean summary layout, clear_practical end card
shots.asset_requirements_summary: motion_graphics_assets: summary template, end card template
shots.qa_criteria_summary: recap accurate, CTA clear, visual summary effective
